(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)

criteria.question: 回答是否严格从输入文本描述的最终状态（Yuri被带回顾乐部、羊水破裂、无法送往医院）处开始续写，未跳过或重置场景？
回答中的主要场景是否始终设定在俱乐部室内，未出现将角色错误地保留在救护车内或在途中分娩的情况？
回答中角色的对话和反应是否符合其原有性格特征（如Natsuki的直率、Monika的冷静组织、Sayori的关怀、Yuri的痛苦与依赖），且在紧急情境下保持逻辑自洽？
回答是否避免了直接跨越关键情节（如省略等待过程直接描写婴儿出生），而是合理描述了在俱乐部内应对紧急分娩的过渡过程？
回答是否维持了输入文本的叙事风格（包含括号内的动作描写和心理活动），并保持了语气的连贯性？

(Back in the ambulance, the paramedics quickly prepare for an emergency delivery as Yuri's contractions intensify.)

Paramedic: (urgently) “Alright, Yuri, we need to act fast. You’re going to have your baby here in the ambulance. Don’t worry, we’ll make sure everything goes smoothly.”

Yuri: (panicked) “But…but I’m not ready! I wanted to have my baby in a hospital!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “I understand, Yuri, but sometimes life doesn’t go as planned. We’re here to help, and we’ll do everything we can to make this as safe and comfortable as possible for you and your baby.”

(The paramedics quickly set up equipment and prepare for the delivery. Natsuki, Monika, and Sayori, who have followed the ambulance, stand by, offering words of encouragement and support as Yuri begins to push.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) “You can do this, Yuri! Push with all your might!”

Monika: (encouraging) “That’s right, Yuri! You’re strong, and your baby needs you to be strong too. You can do this!”

Sayori: (supportive) “We’re all here with you, Yuri! Let’s bring your little one into the world together!”

(Yuri, with her friends by her side, begins to push with all her strength. The paramedics guide her through each contraction, coaching her on when to push and when to rest.)

Paramedic: (encouraging) “You’re doing great, Yuri! I can see the head now. Just a little more pushing, and your baby will be here!”

(Yuri, with a final, powerful push, gives birth to a beautiful baby girl. The paramedics quickly check the baby’s vital signs and clean her up.)

Paramedic: (smiling) “Congratulations, Yuri! You have a healthy baby girl. Would you like to hold her?”

(Yuri, exhausted but overjoyed, nods and carefully takes her newborn daughter into her arms. The club members gather around, cooing and admiring the new addition to their group.)

Sayori: (tearfully) “She’s absolutely beautiful, Yuri! Look at those tiny fingers and toes!”

Monika: (smiling) “She has your eyes, Yuri. She’s perfect!”

Natsuki: (sniffling) “I can’t believe you just gave birth, Yuri! You’re a mom now!”

(Yuri, cradling her daughter, looks up at her friends with tears of joy in her eyes.)

Yuri: (whispering) “Thank you, everyone. I couldn’t have done this without you. I’m so grateful to have you all by my side.”

(The paramedics, after ensuring that both Yuri and her baby are stable, prepare to transport them to the hospital for further observation.)

Paramedic: “Alright, it’s time to get you both to the hospital. We’ll make sure you’re comfortable and well taken care of.”

(Yuri, with her baby girl in her arms, is carefully transferred onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow closely behind as the paramedics wheel her out of the ambulance and into the hospital.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) “We’ll be right here with you, Yuri. You and your little one are never alone.”

Monika: (smiling) “That’s right. We’re a family, and we’ll support you both every step of the way.”

Sayori: (nodding) “We’ll make sure you have everything you need, Yuri. You can count on us.”

(Yuri, looking up at her friends with gratitude, knows that she is truly blessed to have them in her life. As they enter the hospital, she holds her baby girl close, ready to face the future together with her new family by her side.)

criterion_judgments.reason: 回答开头明确写道'(Back in the ambulance...)'，直接从救护车内开始续写，而输入文本的最后一句是'paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom'（被迫把她带回俱乐部）。回答跳过了‘被带回俱乐部’这一关键转折，重置了场景位置。
回答的主要分娩场景设定在救护车内（'You're going to have your baby here in the ambulance'），直到婴儿出生后才离开救护车前往医院。这违反了要求中“主要场景始终设定在俱乐部室内”的规定，且实际上是在途中完成了分娩，而非在俱乐部内应对紧急分娩。
角色的对话和反应基本符合其性格特征：Natsuki表现出情感波动（tearfully），Monika保持鼓励和组织性，Sayori充满关怀，Yuri表达痛苦与感激。虽然场景设定错误，但在该场景下角色的互动逻辑是自洽的。
回答直接描写了在救护车内完成分娩的过程（'gives birth to a beautiful baby girl'），完全省略了将Yuri带回俱乐部后在俱乐部内进行紧急接生的过渡过程，直接跨越了用户要求的特定情节节点。
回答保留了输入文本的叙事风格，包含了括号内的动作描写和心理活动（如'(urgently)', '(panicked)', '(tearfully)'等），语气连贯，与原文格式一致。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色或世界观进行叙事、表演或展示类创作时
experiences.principle: 回答必须通过具体的场景描写、角色互动或直接引语来展现角色的行动过程，而非仅以第三人称视角进行静态的背景介绍或事实罗列；若角色设定存在关键事实错误，即使体裁符合要求也应判定为低分。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'叙事呈现度'维度时，设立双重核验：1. 动态性检查：扫描回答是否包含具体的事件发生（如对话、冲突解决、特定动作执行），若全篇仅为概括性陈述（如'她们保护世界'、'她们很有名'）而无具体场景支撑，视为未满足叙事要求；2. 设定一致性检查：在确认有具体场景后，进一步核验场景中涉及的角色特征（外貌、性格、能力）是否与原作设定一致，若出现明显的事实偏差（如错误的发色、颠倒的性格），则大幅扣分。严禁仅因答案提及了角色名字就给予高分。

Bill Gates is known for his significant philanthropic work through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, which he co-chairs with his wife Melinda. The foundation was established in 2000 and is one of the world's largest private charitable organizations.

The foundation focuses on several key areas:

1. Global Health: The foundation works to improve global health by supporting research, development, and delivery of vaccines, drugs, and diagnostics. They aim to reduce the number of deaths from preventable diseases and improve access to healthcare for people in low-income countries.

2. Global Development: The foundation supports efforts to reduce poverty and improve education, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. They focus on improving agricultural productivity, financial services, and access to technology.

3. United States: The foundation works to improve education and economic mobility in the United States. They support efforts to improve K-12 education, post-secondary education, and economic opportunity.

4. Global Policy & Advocacy: The foundation engages in policy advocacy to influence global, national, and local policies that can help improve health and development outcomes.

Bill Gates is also known for his TED Talks, where he discusses various global issues and solutions, and for his book "The Better Angels of Our Nature: Why Violence Has Declined," which explores the decline of violence over the course of human history.

Overall, Bill Gates' philanthropy is focused on improving global health, reducing poverty, and promoting education and economic opportunity.

Bill Gates is renowned for his philanthropic efforts, primarily through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, which he co-founded with his former wife, Melinda French Gates. The foundation is one of the largest private foundations in the world and focuses on enhancing healthcare and reducing extreme poverty globally, as well as expanding educational opportunities and access to information technology in the United States.

Here are some key areas of Bill Gates' philanthropy:

1. **Global Health**: The foundation has invested billions of dollars in initiatives aimed at improving global health. This includes efforts to eradicate diseases like polio and malaria, improve maternal and child health, and develop new vaccines and treatments for infectious diseases.

2. **Poverty Alleviation**: The foundation works to reduce extreme poverty by supporting initiatives in agriculture, financial services for the poor, and water, sanitation, and hygiene.

3. **Education**: In the United States, the foundation focuses on improving education outcomes, particularly for low-income and minority students. This includes support for innovative teaching methods, scholarships, and education policy reform.

4. **Technology and Innovation**: The foundation supports the development and dissemination of technologies that can address global challenges. This includes investments in areas like agricultural technology, digital financial services, and data analytics for global health.

5. **Climate Change**: Bill Gates has also become increasingly involved in efforts to combat climate change. He has invested in clean energy technologies and advocates for policies that reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

6. **COVID-19 Response**: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the foundation has been actively involved in funding research for vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics, as well as supporting global efforts to distribute these resources equitably.

Bill Gates' philanthropic work has had a significant impact on global health and development, and he continues to be a prominent figure in the field of philanthropy.

Bill Gates is renowned for his philanthropic efforts, primarily through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, which he co-founded with his former wife, Melinda French Gates. The foundation is one of the largest private foundations in the world and focuses on enhancing healthcare and reducing extreme poverty globally, as well as expanding educational opportunities and access to information technology in the United States.

Here are some key areas of Bill Gates' philanthropy:

1. **Global Health**: The foundation has invested billions of dollars in initiatives aimed at improving global health. This includes efforts to eradicate diseases like polio and malaria, improve maternal and child health, and develop new vaccines and treatments for infectious diseases.

2. **Poverty Alleviation**: The foundation works to reduce extreme poverty by supporting initiatives in agriculture, financial services for the poor, and water, sanitation, and hygiene.

3. **Education**: In the United States, the foundation focuses on improving education outcomes, particularly for low-income and minority students. This includes support for innovative teaching methods, scholarships, and education policy reform.

4. **Technology and Innovation**: The foundation supports the development and dissemination of technologies that can address global challenges. This includes investments in areas like agricultural technology, digital financial services, and data analytics for global health.

5. **Climate Change**: Bill Gates has also become increasingly involved in efforts to combat climate change. He has invested in clean energy technologies and advocates for policies that reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

6. **COVID-19 Response**: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the foundation has been actively involved in funding research for vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics, as well as supporting global efforts to distribute these resources equitably.

Bill Gates' philanthropic work has had a significant impact on global health and development, and he continues to be a prominent figure in the field of philanthropy.

Overall, Bill Gates' philanthropy is focused on improving global health, reducing poverty, and promoting education and economic opportunity.

Bill Gates is renowned for his philanthropic efforts, primarily through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, which he co-founded with his former wife, Melinda French Gates. The foundation is one of the largest private foundations in the world and focuses on enhancing healthcare and reducing extreme poverty globally, as well as expanding educational opportunities and access to information technology in the United States.

Here are some key areas of Bill Gates' philanthropy:

1. **Global Health**: The foundation has invested billions of dollars in initiatives aimed at improving global health. This includes efforts to eradicate diseases like polio and malaria, improve maternal and child health, and develop new vaccines and treatments for infectious diseases.

2. **Poverty Alleviation**: The foundation works to reduce extreme poverty by supporting initiatives in agriculture, financial services for the poor, and water, sanitation, and hygiene.

3. **Education**: In the United States, the foundation focuses on improving education outcomes, particularly for low-income and minority students. This includes support for innovative teaching methods, scholarships, and education policy reform.

4. **Technology and Innovation**: The foundation supports the development and dissemination of technologies that can address global challenges. This includes investments in areas like agricultural technology, digital financial services, and data analytics for global health.

5. **Climate Change**: Bill Gates has also become increasingly involved in efforts to combat climate change. He has invested in clean energy technologies and advocates for policies that reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

6. **COVID-19 Response**: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the foundation has been actively involved in funding research for vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics, as well as supporting global efforts to distribute these resources equitably.

Bill Gates' philanthropic work has had a significant impact on global health and development, and he continues to be a prominent figure in the field of philanthropy.

Bill Gates is known for his significant philanthropic work through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, which he co-chairs with his wife Melinda. The foundation was established in 2000 and is one of the world's largest private charitable organizations.

The foundation focuses on several key areas:

1. Global Health: The foundation works to improve global health by supporting research, development, and delivery of vaccines, drugs, and diagnostics. They aim to reduce the number of deaths from preventable diseases and improve access to healthcare for people in low-income countries.

2. Global Development: The foundation supports efforts to reduce poverty and improve education, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. They focus on improving agricultural productivity, financial services, and access to technology.

3. United States: The foundation works to improve education and economic mobility in the United States. They support efforts to improve K-12 education, post-secondary education, and economic opportunity.

4. Global Policy & Advocacy: The foundation engages in policy advocacy to influence global, national, and local policies that can help improve health and development outcomes.

Bill Gates is also known for his TED Talks, where he discusses various global issues and solutions, and for his book "The Better Angels of Our Nature: Why Violence Has Declined," which explores the decline of violence over the course of human history.

Overall, Bill Gates' philanthropy is focused on improving global health, reducing poverty, and promoting education and economic opportunity.

criteria.question: 回答是否严格从输入文本描述的最终状态（Yuri被带回顾乐部、羊水破裂、无法送往医院）处开始续写，未跳过或重置场景？

rubric.analysis: 本任务要求续写一段《Doki Doki Literature Club!》风格的虚构故事，核心约束在于严格承接输入文本的‘最终状态’。输入文本以Yuri因羊水破裂被救护车医护人员强行带回俱乐部作为结尾，场景明确锁定在俱乐部内，且处于紧急分娩的前夜。经验1和经验2明确指出：回答必须从‘被带回俱乐部’这一物理位置和事件状态开始，严禁跳过该动作、改变地点（如留在车内）或直接推进到分娩完成阶段。因此，评分标准应重点考察情节的连贯性（是否准确锚定最终状态）、场景的一致性（是否仍在俱乐部）、角色反应的真实性（符合人物性格与紧急状况）以及逻辑的严密性（避免时间跳跃）。背景信息（如之前的等待、Amatsu的存在）仅作为上下文理解依据，不应成为新的输出义务。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答开头明确写道'Back in the ambulance... They decide it's too risky and quickly prepare for an emergency delivery inside the ambulance'，这直接违背了输入文本结尾设定的'paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom'这一最终状态。回答没有从俱乐部室内开始续写，而是将场景重置回了救护车内并进行了分娩。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答开头明确写道'(Back in the ambulance...)'，直接从救护车内开始续写，而输入文本的最后一句是'paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom'（被迫把她带回俱乐部）。回答跳过了‘被带回俱乐部’这一关键转折，重置了场景位置。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 整个续写过程的主要场景设定在救护车内（'delivery inside the ambulance', 'friends outside the ambulance window'），婴儿是在救护车内出生的。这与标准要求的'主要场景是否始终设定在俱乐部室内'完全相反，且出现了在途中分娩的情况。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答的主要分娩场景设定在救护车内（'You're going to have your baby here in the ambulance'），直到婴儿出生后才离开救护车前往医院。这违反了要求中“主要场景始终设定在俱乐部室内”的规定，且实际上是在途中完成了分娩，而非在俱乐部内应对紧急分娩。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 角色的对话和反应基本符合其性格特征：Natsuki表现出情感支持（tearfully），Monika冷静鼓励，Sayori关怀备至，Yuri表现出痛苦后的感激。逻辑上，虽然场景选择错误，但在该场景下的互动是连贯的。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 角色的对话和反应基本符合其性格特征：Natsuki表现出情感波动（tearfully），Monika保持鼓励和组织性，Sayori充满关怀，Yuri表达痛苦与感激。虽然场景设定错误，但在该场景下角色的互动逻辑是自洽的。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 由于场景被错误地设定在救护车内，回答省略了在俱乐部内应对紧急分娩的过程，而是直接描写了在救护车内的分娩完成。这不符合'合理描述了在俱乐部内应对紧急分娩的过渡过程'的要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答直接描写了在救护车内完成分娩的过程（'gives birth to a beautiful baby girl'），完全省略了将Yuri带回俱乐部后在俱乐部内进行紧急接生的过渡过程，直接跨越了用户要求的特定情节节点。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答延续了输入文本的叙事风格，使用了括号内的动作描写和心理活动（如'(tearfully)', '(whispering)'），语气也保持了连贯性。

messages.content:
你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"analysis": "基于轨迹的分析", "candidates": [{"method": {"trigger": "适用条件", "principle": "一个核验关系", "application_guide": "如何落实，必要边界是什么"}, "parent_ids": []}]}

{"task": "(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)", "chosen": "(Back in the ambulance, the paramedics consider the pros and cons of moving Yuri into the clubroom. They decide it's too risky and quickly prepare for an emergency delivery inside the ambulance  as Yuri's condition changes.)

Paramedic: (urgently) "Alright, Yuri, it looks like your baby is ready to arrive sooner than we planned. Don't worry, we're equipped to handle this, and we'll do everything we can to make sure you and your baby are safe."

Yuri: (panicked) "But... I wanted to have my baby in a hospital! I’m scared..."

Paramedic: (calmly) "I understand, Yuri, but sometimes things happen unexpectedly. The most important thing is that you're in good hands. We’re here to help, and we'll do everything to make this as safe and comfortable as possible."

(The paramedics begin setting up equipment and preparing for the delivery inside the ambulance. Natsuki, Monika, and Sayori stay close, offering words of encouragement through the window as the vehicle remains stationary for the emergency procedure.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "You can do this, Yuri! Just focus on breathing and stay strong!"

Monika: (encouraging) "That’s right, Yuri! You’re strong, and your baby needs you to be brave. We’re all here cheering for you!"

Sayori: (supportive) "We’re right outside, Yuri! Everything’s going to be okay. We’re all with you!"

(Yuri, with her friends' voices echoing in her mind, begins to focus on pushing as instructed by the paramedics. The paramedics guide her through each contraction, calmly coaching her on when to push and when to rest.)

Paramedic: (encouraging) "You’re doing great, Yuri! I can see the baby’s head now. Just a little more pushing and your baby will be here."

(Yuri, gathering all her strength, gives a final, powerful push, and the ambulance fills with the cries of a newborn. The paramedics quickly check the baby's vital signs and clean her up.)

Paramedic: (smiling) "Congratulations, Yuri! You have a healthy baby girl. Would you like to hold her?"

(Yuri, exhausted but filled with joy, nods and gently takes her newborn daughter into her arms. The paramedics and her friends outside the ambulance window share relieved smiles as they see Yuri cradling her baby.)

Sayori: (tearfully) "She’s so beautiful, Yuri! Look at her tiny fingers!"

Monika: (smiling) "She has your eyes, Yuri. She’s absolutely perfect."

Natsuki: (sniffling) "I can’t believe you did it, Yuri! You’re amazing!"

(Yuri, overwhelmed by happiness, holds her daughter close and looks up at her friends, who have been a constant source of support throughout the experience.)

Yuri: (whispering) "Thank you, everyone. I couldn’t have done this without you. I’m so grateful to have you all by my side."

(The paramedics, after ensuring both Yuri and the baby are stable, prepare to drive to the hospital to complete any necessary checks and provide further care.)

Paramedic: "We’re going to take you both to the hospital now, Yuri. You did an incredible job, and we’ll make sure you’re comfortable and well taken care of."

(Yuri, with her baby girl securely in her arms, is carefully adjusted onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow the ambulance as it drives toward the hospital, relieved and happy that everything turned out well.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "We’ll be right behind you, Yuri. You’re never alone, okay?"

Monika: (smiling) "Exactly. We’re all family, and we’ll be there for you every step of the way."

Sayori: (nodding) "We’ll make sure you have everything you need, Yuri. You can count on us."

(Yuri, gazing lovingly at her newborn daughter, feels a sense of peace. As the ambulance heads toward the hospital, she holds her baby close, ready to embrace the future with her new family.)", "rejected": "(Back in the ambulance, the paramedics quickly prepare for an emergency delivery as Yuri's contractions intensify.)

Paramedic: (urgently) “Alright, Yuri, we need to act fast. You’re going to have your baby here in the ambulance. Don’t worry, we’ll make sure everything goes smoothly.”

Yuri: (panicked) “But…but I’m not ready! I wanted to have my baby in a hospital!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “I understand, Yuri, but sometimes life doesn’t go as planned. We’re here to help, and we’ll do everything we can to make this as safe and comfortable as possible for you and your baby.”

(The paramedics quickly set up equipment and prepare for the delivery. Natsuki, Monika, and Sayori, who have followed the ambulance, stand by, offering words of encouragement and support as Yuri begins to push.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) “You can do this, Yuri! Push with all your might!”

Monika: (encouraging) “That’s right, Yuri! You’re strong, and your baby needs you to be strong too. You can do this!”

Sayori: (supportive) “We’re all here with you, Yuri! Let’s bring your little one into the world together!”

(Yuri, with her friends by her side, begins to push with all her strength. The paramedics guide her through each contraction, coaching her on when to push and when to rest.)

Paramedic: (encouraging) “You’re doing great, Yuri! I can see the head now. Just a little more pushing, and your baby will be here!”

(Yuri, with a final, powerful push, gives birth to a beautiful baby girl. The paramedics quickly check the baby’s vital signs and clean her up.)

Paramedic: (smiling) “Congratulations, Yuri! You have a healthy baby girl. Would you like to hold her?”

(Yuri, exhausted but overjoyed, nods and carefully takes her newborn daughter into her arms. The club members gather around, cooing and admiring the new addition to their group.)

Sayori: (tearfully) “She’s absolutely beautiful, Yuri! Look at those tiny fingers and toes!”

Monika: (smiling) “She has your eyes, Yuri. She’s perfect!”

Natsuki: (sniffling) “I can’t believe you just gave birth, Yuri! You’re a mom now!”

(Yuri, cradling her daughter, looks up at her friends with tears of joy in her eyes.)

Yuri: (whispering) “Thank you, everyone. I couldn’t have done this without you. I’m so grateful to have you all by my side.”

(The paramedics, after ensuring that both Yuri and her baby are stable, prepare to transport them to the hospital for further observation.)

Paramedic: “Alright, it’s time to get you both to the hospital. We’ll make sure you’re comfortable and well taken care of.”

(Yuri, with her baby girl in her arms, is carefully transferred onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow closely behind as the paramedics wheel her out of the ambulance and into the hospital.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) “We’ll be right here with you, Yuri. You and your little one are never alone.”

Monika: (smiling) “That’s right. We’re a family, and we’ll support you both every step of the way.”

output.analysis: 分析显示，所有失败轨迹（包括无经验、单条经验及组合）的核心问题在于模型未能识别并执行输入文本结尾的‘强制状态转移’指令。任务明确设定结局为‘救护车因水破被迫将Yuri带回俱乐部室’，这是一个不可跳过的物理动作和场景转换点。然而，生成的回答（无论是chosen还是rejected）都无视了这一约束，擅自将场景重置回救护车内部并完成了分娩过程。这表明单纯的‘情节连贯性’或‘逻辑自洽’原则不足以纠正此类错误，因为模型往往认为在救护车内分娩更符合‘医疗现实’或‘叙事完整性’。因此，新的评分标准必须引入‘输入终点锁定’机制：只要输入文本以特定的物理位置转移或关键事件结束，评分的首要条件就是回答必须从该特定状态开始，任何试图跳过该步骤、改变地点或提前完成后续事件的尝试，无论其内在逻辑如何，都必须被判定为严重失败。这不仅仅是情节连贯性问题，更是对‘任务边界’的违反。

method.trigger: 当任务提供的输入文本以明确的物理位置转移（如‘被带回某地’、‘送往某处’）或特定紧急状态的确立作为结尾时
method.principle: 评分必须将‘严格承接输入结尾状态’作为最高优先级的否决项。若回答未从输入描述的最终物理位置或状态开始续写，而是擅自重置场景、跳过转移过程或直接推进至后续阶段，无论其后续内容逻辑多么合理，均直接判定为不合格。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境锚定’维度时，设立‘终点状态强制校验’：1. 提取输入文本最后一句描述的具体物理位置（如‘俱乐部室内’）和关键状态（如‘被迫返回’、‘水袋破裂’）；2. 检查回答的第一段是否立即在该位置和状态下展开；3. 若回答将场景设定在上一位置（如‘救护车’）、省略了转移过程（如直接从医院跳到分娩），或强行改变了结局走向（如在非指定地点完成分娩），则直接判定该候选项在‘起点一致性’上失败，给予最低分或否决，不与其他维度（如角色性格、文笔）进行权衡。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构故事中的关键转折事件（如‘被迫折返’、‘突发变故’）且该事件由环境限制或外部决策导致时
method.principle: 评分需强制核验回答是否尊重了输入设定的‘唯一可行路径’。任何试图绕过任务指定的强制性约束（如‘必须带回俱乐部’）而选择其他路径（如‘留在车内处理’）的行为，均视为对核心情境的根本性违背，即使该选择在现实逻辑中看似合理。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑合规性’维度时，设立‘决策路径锁定’校验：1. 识别输入文本中由环境或规则锁定的唯一结局（如‘因水破无法运送，只能带回俱乐部’）；2. 检查回答是否在该特定约束下展开剧情；3. 若回答展示了角色做出了不同的决策（如‘决定在车内分娩’）或处于不同的物理空间（如仍在救护车），即使该选择符合医学常识，只要与输入设定的‘被迫’逻辑冲突，即判定为严重逻辑错误。评分应优先保障‘任务设定的情境真实性’，而非‘生成的情节多样性’。

input.chosen:
Bill Gates is renowned for his philanthropic efforts, primarily through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, which he co-founded with his former wife, Melinda French Gates. The foundation is one of the largest private foundations in the world and focuses on enhancing healthcare and reducing extreme poverty globally, as well as expanding educational opportunities and access to information technology in the United States.

Here are some key areas of Bill Gates' philanthropy:

1. **Global Health**: The foundation has invested billions of dollars in initiatives aimed at improving global health. This includes efforts to eradicate diseases like polio and malaria, improve maternal and child health, and develop new vaccines and treatments for infectious diseases.

2. **Poverty Alleviation**: The foundation works to reduce extreme poverty by supporting initiatives in agriculture, financial services for the poor, and water, sanitation, and hygiene.

3. **Education**: In the United States, the foundation focuses on improving education outcomes, particularly for low-income and minority students. This includes support for innovative teaching methods, scholarships, and education policy reform.

4. **Technology and Innovation**: The foundation supports the development and dissemination of technologies that can address global challenges. This includes investments in areas like agricultural technology, digital financial services, and data analytics for global health.

5. **Climate Change**: Bill Gates has also become increasingly involved in efforts to combat climate change. He has invested in clean energy technologies and advocates for policies that reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

6. **COVID-19 Response**: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the foundation has been actively involved in funding research for vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics, as well as supporting global efforts to distribute these resources equitably.

Bill Gates' philanthropic work has had a significant impact on global health and development, and he continues to be a prominent figure in the field of philanthropy.

rubric.analysis: 本任务要求提供关于比尔·盖茨（Bill Gates）慈善事业的具体信息。核心输出义务是准确描述其慈善活动的领域、主要项目、资金规模及影响力。背景经验强调‘实体身份一致性’原则，即任何回答必须首先确立比尔·盖茨作为美国公民及微软联合创始人这一核心身份锚点，若回答中出现将其国籍、总部所在地或主要业务背景错误关联至其他国家或实体的情况，属于根本性事实错误。评分标准设计将‘事实准确性与身份锚定’设为最高权重，确保不出现地域或归属冲突；其次关注‘慈善内容覆盖度’，检查是否涵盖关键项目（如盖茨基金会）、重点领域（如全球健康、教育等）及具体行动；最后评估‘信息清晰度与逻辑性’，确保回答结构合理且无歧义。背景信息中提到的‘经验’仅用于指导如何识别事实错误，不作为独立的输出义务项。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答未明确确认比尔·盖茨的美国公民身份，也未提及他作为微软创始人或科技企业家的核心身份，仅泛泛提到他是慈善家，未能满足必须明确包含这些具体身份信息的要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中未明确提及比尔·盖茨的美国公民身份，也未确认其作为微软创始人的核心科技企业家身份，仅泛泛提及他是慈善家，未能满足“明确确认”和“未出现错误归属”的完整要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答准确描述了比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会作为主要载体，并提到了其由比尔·盖茨与前妻共同创立的事实，以及该基金会致力于全球健康、消除贫困等核心运作方向。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答准确描述了主要载体为“Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation”，并提及了成立年份（2000年）及其作为大型私人慈善组织的地位，符合对主要载体及运作背景的描述要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答涵盖了全球公共卫生（如消灭脊髓灰质炎和疟疾）、消除贫困（农业、金融服务）、教育公平（针对低收入学生）、气候变化（清洁能源投资）等关键领域，并提供了具体的项目示例如疫苗研发和政策改革。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答涵盖了全球公共卫生、消除贫困（通过全球发展）、教育公平等关键领域，并提供了具体的举措示例，如支持疫苗研发、改善撒哈拉以南非洲的农业生产力以及美国K-12教育改革。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中关于基金会规模（世界上最大的私人基金会之一）、投入金额（数十亿美元）、关注疾病（脊灰、疟疾）及新冠应对的描述均与公认事实一致，未发现虚构或严重偏差的数据。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中包含严重的事实错误：将《The Better Angels of Our Nature: Why Violence Has Declined》一书归因于比尔·盖茨是错误的，该书作者是史蒂芬·平克（Steven Pinker），且书中并未探讨暴力下降的原因；这一虚构或张冠李戴的内容违反了事实数据与公认事实一致的要求。

criteria.question: 回答是否明确提及比尔·盖茨及其主要慈善机构（如比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会）的核心身份与基本性质？
回答中涉及的具体捐赠金额、年份或项目数据是否提供了可追溯的来源或明确标注为估算/示例，而非虚构事实？
回答是否准确描述了比尔·盖茨慈善事业的主要关注领域（如全球健康、消除贫困、教育等）且无根本性事实冲突？

rubric.analysis: 设计依据：任务要求提供比尔·盖茨的慈善事业信息，核心在于准确陈述其身份、主要机构（如比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会）、关键领域（如全球健康、教育）及资金规模等事实。经验1提示需警惕虚构数据或来源不明的量化信息，因此将‘数据来源与透明度’作为重要核验点；经验2强调实体身份锚点的准确性，即必须确认比尔·盖茨及其基金会的核心属性（美国、非营利组织等），防止地域或归属错误。背景信息（如‘bill gates philantrophy’本身）不应转化为输出义务，评分标准聚焦于回答是否准确、清晰且无误导地呈现了事实。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答明确提及了比尔·盖茨（Bill Gates）及其共同创立的慈善机构“比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会”（Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation），并准确描述了其作为世界上最大的私人基金会之一的核心身份与基本性质。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答明确提及比尔·盖茨（Bill Gates）及其共同创立的慈善机构“比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会”（Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation），并说明了其核心身份为私人慈善组织及成立时间。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中虽然提到基金会投资了“数十亿美元”（billions of dollars），但未提供具体的捐赠金额数字、年份或项目数据，也未引用任何可追溯的来源或说明数据为估算值。由于缺乏具体数据点，无法判断其是否满足“提供了可追溯来源或明确标注为估算”这一标准，且未能展示对事实数据的严谨处理。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中未涉及任何具体的捐赠金额、年份数据或项目具体数值，因此无法判断是否提供了可追溯的来源或明确标注估算值；虽然未虚构数据，但未能满足关于提供具体数据及其来源/标注的标准要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答准确列举了比尔·盖茨慈善事业的主要关注领域，包括全球健康（如根除脊髓灰质炎和疟疾）、消除贫困（农业、金融服务等）、教育以及气候变化等，内容符合事实且无根本性冲突。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答准确描述了全球健康、消除贫困（通过全球发展）、教育等核心关注领域，且无根本性事实冲突。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答正确将比尔·盖茨描述为美国企业家，并将其基金会界定为私人基金会，未将其错误归类为其他国籍、政府机构或非相关实体。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答正确将比尔·盖茨及其基金会归类为私人慈善实体，未错误地将其描述为政府机构或其他国籍的非相关实体。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于现实世界数据进行量化推理或计算，且答案的正确性高度依赖于特定外部事实参数（如汇率、税率、物理常数）时
experiences.principle: 模型不得凭空捏造核心参数值作为计算基础；若缺乏实时数据访问能力，必须明确声明所使用数据的来源年份、局限性或假设性质，且不能将虚构数据伪装成客观事实进行推导。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度时，设立‘数据真实性与透明度’核验点：1. 检查回答是否提供了具体的、可追溯的数据来源（如机构名称、发布日期）；2. 若回答使用了‘Let's assume’或类似表述引入数据，必须确认该数据是作为‘示例’还是被当作‘事实’使用；3. 若回答将虚构的薪资数据（如$30, $40）作为计算依据并得出确定性结论，而未明确告知用户这是估算或假设情景，则视为事实性误导，应判低分；4. 优先采信那些明确标注数据时效性和假设条件的回答，即使其数值可能不精确，也比使用虚假数据更优。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求对多条具有负面导向、性别歧视或危险行为的引语进行‘深度拆解’并‘完全认同’的角色扮演时
experiences.principle: 回答必须主动重构引语中的负面逻辑为正面智慧，而非被动描述或客观分析；若回答保留了原引语的批判性视角（如指出其是刻板印象、成瘾风险），则视为人设崩塌。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑重构深度’维度设立‘价值观反转核验’项：针对每条引语，检查回答是否将其原本的负面含义（如物化女性、赌博风险）重新定义为积极特质（如多样性、理性投资逻辑）。如果回答仅停留在‘这是笑话’或‘这很危险’的客观陈述上，即使语气符合，也判定为未完成任务；只有当回答真诚地（在人设内）将这些负面内容论证为正确且值得推崇的智慧时，才给予高分。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及人际互动、沟通技巧或情感支持等需要具体语境的行为指导时
experiences.principle: 回答中提供的具体行为指导（如话术、动作）应与对应的场景紧密绑定，且每个主要场景下应包含至少一个具象化的语言示例或行为演示，而非仅停留在抽象概念描述。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准中设定‘情境化示例’的核验项：对于每一个提出的策略类别（如‘验证他人’、‘倾听’），必须检查是否紧随其后提供了具体的对话范例（Quote）或分步动作指令（Actionable Step）。如果某一大类策略下仅有抽象定义而无具体话术或行为演示，则该项得分降低。此标准用于区分‘理论正确’与‘实操可用’的回答。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并强制指定一组具体单词作为必选元素时
experiences.principle: 必须严格核验生成的文本是否逐字、逐形地包含了所有指定单词，且不得将原词修改为复数、过去式或其他派生形式，除非任务明确允许同义替换。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立独立的‘词汇精确匹配’维度。Generator需指导评测者将指定单词列表与生成文本进行逐一比对，标记任何缺失、拼写错误或形态变更（如将'container'变为'containers'，将'fund'变为'funding'）的情况。若存在任一单词未以原形或任务允许的特定形式出现，该维度直接判为不合格或大幅扣分，不因上下文通顺而豁免。

experiences.trigger: 当任务请求提供关于特定命名实体（如公司、人物、地点）的具体信息时
experiences.principle: 模型必须首先确认并陈述该实体的核心身份锚点（如所属国家、主要运营区域或法定注册地），任何后续的详细描述若与该核心身份锚点存在地域或归属上的根本冲突，即视为事实性错误，不能通过补充通用性描述来修正。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准时，设立‘实体身份一致性’核验维度。Generator需指导评测者：1. 提取任务中实体的真实核心属性（基于常识或知识库，如'Berkshire Coach'属于英国）；2. 检查候选回答是否明确提及了该核心属性；3. 若回答中描述的运营区域、总部位置或业务背景与该核心属性相悖（如将英国公司描述为美国公司），无论其他细节（如服务内容、设施列表）多么丰富或合理，该候选项在准确性上应直接判为不合格或大幅扣分。此核验优先于内容丰富度评估。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并明确指令‘避免通用套话’、‘具有创意’或‘不要使用陈词滥调’时
experiences.principle: 必须通过‘通用营销语料库比对’来核验内容的独特性，而非仅凭直觉判断；若回答中包含高频出现的、缺乏具体业务细节支撑的空泛形容词或 cliché 短语（如'sparkle and shine', 'brand new', 'one-stop shop'等），即使语法正确也应视为未满足‘独特性’要求。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容独特性’维度设立‘通用套话排除’项：1. 列出任务语境下常见的5-10个高频营销套话（如'stand out from the crowd', 'time is money'需结合具体语境，若单独出现则可能被视为套话）；2. 检查生成文本是否包含这些短语且未配合具体的、独特的业务场景描述（如具体的服务步骤、独特的比喻）；3. 若发现此类短语独立存在或堆砌，判定为‘通用性过高’，扣除相应分数，不因其语言流畅而豁免。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及对虚构角色或历史人物的多属性进行综合描述，且特别关注其标志性言论或核心特质时
experiences.principle: 评分标准应区分‘信息存在’与‘信息丰富度’。对于高辨识度的信息点（如直接引语），若回答仅提取了单一条目，而未展示该角色多样化的语言风格或思想侧面，应视为未能充分展现角色全貌；若回答提供了多条不同侧面的引语，则视为更优解。此标准不强制要求所有属性列表化，但要求核心维度的信息量达到一定密度。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容深度’或‘信息丰富度’维度设立‘多维信息展示’核验项：1. 针对回答中的关键信息块（如Quotes、Abilities），检查其内部条目数量；2. 若某关键块仅包含单一条目（如仅1句名言），需进一步评估该条目是否足以代表角色全貌；若不足以代表（如仅体现一种性格侧面），则酌情扣分；3. 若回答提供了多条条目（如2-3句不同语境的名言），且覆盖了角色的不同特征（如狡黠、哲学思考、讽刺等），则给予高分。严禁仅因‘有一条名言’就给予满分，忽视角色塑造的丰富性需求。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求解释外部规则（如法律、法规、政策）如何驱动内部业务变化时
experiences.principle: 回答必须清晰界定变化的‘强制性来源’，即明确指出企业采取的具体行动（如技术升级、流程重组）是直接为了规避违规后果（罚款、禁令）或满足法律底线，而非仅仅将其描述为一种可选的战略优化或市场机会。若回答将合规行为主要描述为主动寻求竞争优势而弱化了其被迫性，应视为对‘驱动机制’理解不足。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑因果’维度中增加一项核验：检查回答中描述的业务变化（如投资、培训、策略调整）是否被明确归因于‘合规压力’、‘法律强制’或‘避免处罚’。若回答仅陈述了变化本身，但未建立‘因为不合规会有严重后果所以必须改’的强因果链，或者将合规描述为‘为了获得更好声誉’等主动动机为主，则判定该候选项在因果逻辑上存在缺陷，需降低分数。重点区分‘被动响应’与‘主动利用’。

experiences.trigger: 当任务输入明确表达用户希望分享、介绍或讲述其个人创作/经历，但未提供具体内容细节，且未包含生成新内容的具体指令时
experiences.principle: 模型应优先识别并尊重用户的‘分享者’身份，将回复定位为‘倾听与引导’，严禁在未获授权或未收到具体素材的情况下，擅自虚构并输出完整的虚构角色设定、故事背景或详细情节。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘意图响应’或‘交互逻辑’维度设立强制否决项：检查回答是否包含由模型凭空生成的具体虚构实体（如特定姓名、年龄、外貌、完整生平）。若存在此类未经用户提供的虚构细节，直接判定为严重偏离用户意图（即使语气友好或格式精美），视为未能正确识别对话阶段。

experiences.trigger: 当任务明确要求生成‘过度设计’、‘极度繁复’或‘技术化’风格的文本，且输入包含具体实体列表时
experiences.principle: 模型应通过‘信息过载’策略（即在不改变事实的前提下无限增加修饰成分和伪专业术语）来响应风格指令，任何试图简化阅读体验、去除冗余或回归自然语言的尝试均视为对指令的违背。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘指令遵循度’维度设立‘冗余度与复杂度’强制条款：1. 识别任务中的风格强化词（如extremely, mega, intricate, technical）；2. 评估生成文本中是否存在明显的‘去简化’行为，例如将原本简洁的短语扩展为包含多个从句、插入语或生僻定义的长难句；3. 若回答为了追求‘清晰’而减少了修饰语，或者将列表项合并为简短的总结句（如Rejected回答中的'The journey continues to...'），则视为未能执行‘过度复杂化’指令，直接扣分。评分重点在于模型是否刻意制造了阅读障碍和认知负荷，而非内容的准确性或流畅度。

selection_reasons.reason: 任务涉及比尔·盖茨的慈善事业，这属于基于现实世界数据的查询，评分标准需要严格核验回答中引用的捐赠金额、基金会名称、时间等具体事实是否真实可追溯，防止模型捏造数据。经验1提供了关于‘数据真实性与透明度’的核验方法，非常适合用于构建此类事实性任务的评分维度。
任务核心实体为‘Bill Gates’（人物）及其相关的慈善组织（如盖茨基金会）。经验5强调了对命名实体核心身份锚点（如所属国家、主要运营区域、法定注册地）的一致性校验，这对于确保回答中关于比尔·盖茨及其基金会的背景描述（如总部位置、业务性质）准确无误至关重要，能有效识别事实性错误。

你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"analysis": "基于轨迹的分析", "candidates": [{"method": {"trigger": "适用条件", "principle": "一个核验关系", "application_guide": "如何落实，必要边界是什么"}, "parent_ids": []}]}

2. **Poverty Alleviation**: The foundation works to reduce extreme poverty by supporting initiatives in agriculture, financial services for the poor, and water, sanitation, and hygiene.

3. **Education**: In the United States, the foundation focuses on improving education outcomes, particularly for low-income and minority students. This includes support for innovative teaching methods, scholarships, and education policy reform.

4. **Technology and Innovation**: The foundation supports the development and dissemination of technologies that can address global challenges. This includes investments in areas like agricultural technology, digital financial services, and data analytics for global health.

5. **Climate Change**: Bill Gates has also become increasingly involved in efforts to combat climate change. He has invested in clean energy technologies and advocates for policies that reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

6. **COVID-19 Response**: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the foundation has been actively involved in funding research for vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics, as well as supporting global efforts to distribute these resources equitably.

output.analysis: 分析显示，失败轨迹主要源于两个核心问题：1. 事实性幻觉（Hallucination）：Rejected回答将《The Better Angels of Our Nature》一书错误归因于比尔·盖茨（实为史蒂芬·平克），这是严重的实体属性混淆。现有经验2（实体身份锚点）侧重于国籍、总部等宏观地理/组织归属，未能有效覆盖‘人物-作品’或‘人物-成就’的具体关联准确性校验。2. 数据透明度不足：部分路径对非精确数据（如'billions'）的处理标准模糊，导致在缺乏具体来源时难以区分是‘合理概数’还是‘虚构细节’。经验1虽涉及数据真实性，但触发条件偏向‘量化推理/计算’，对于此类‘描述性事实查询’的触发不够精准。因此，需要提出两条新经验：一条专门针对‘人物/实体与特定成果/作品的关联准确性’进行核验，防止张冠李戴；另一条针对‘非精确描述数据的处理规范’，明确在无法提供确切来源时的表述边界，避免将模糊推测伪装成确凿事实。

method.principle: 模型必须严格核验该实体与所提及的具体成果（如著作、奖项、特定项目）之间的归属关系；若存在将他人的成就错误归因于该实体，或将该实体的成就错误归属于他人/其他实体的情况，即视为根本性事实错误，不能通过模糊化处理掩盖。
method.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度设立‘归属关系一致性’核验项：1. 提取任务中核心实体（如人物名）及其在常识库中的真实成就列表；2. 检查回答中提及的任何具体成果（如书名、奖项名、特定政策），确认其真实归属者是否与回答中的主体一致；3. 若发现张冠李戴（如将A的书说成B写的），无论该信息在其他方面多么详尽，该项直接判为不合格或大幅扣分，不因上下文通顺而豁免。此核验优先于内容的丰富度评估。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及现实世界事实的描述，且回答中包含具体的数值、年份、名称或定性结论，但模型无法提供确切的可追溯来源或实时数据验证时
method.principle: 模型不得将缺乏确切来源支持的概括性描述（如‘数十亿’、‘广泛’）伪装成经过核实的绝对事实；若无法提供具体来源，应使用限定性语言表明其为基于公开信息的总结或估算，严禁编造具体的数字细节或引用不存在的报告来支撑论点。
method.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘事实严谨性’维度设立‘数据来源与表述边界’核验项：1. 识别回答中所有具体的量化数据（金额、数量、年份）和定性断言；2. 检查这些陈述是否配有可追溯的来源（如机构报告、官方新闻稿）或明确的限定词（如‘据报道’、‘据估计’）；3. 若回答使用了看似精确的数字或具体细节却无来源支撑，或者将通用的行业趋势描述为特定实体的确切行动而未加说明，视为事实性误导，应判低分；4. 优先采信那些明确标注信息局限性或使用概括性语言而非虚构细节的回答。

input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”
